notes.title: Phosfi Demo Update - 4/30/25
notes.content:
[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

This update aims to bring some more features to the demo as well as keep the systems in line with the upcoming full release of Phosfi.

[h3]Detailed Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated character movement physics and input response.
[*] Added Wave Slash special ability.
[*] Added additional rest sequence when sleeping in Sanctuary Rooms.
[*] Added new visual and musical effects to collecting power-ups
[*] Updated visual and audio effects for boss encounters.
[*] Stability improvements and small bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Phosfi Demo Update - 3/1/24
notes.content:
A new update for the Phosfi Demo is now live!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated art assets in temple areas
[*] Updated movement acceleration
[*] Updated in air control slightly
[*] Adjustments to momentum conservation to make motions feel less floaty
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where playing at a very low framerate could lead to jellyfish bouncing not working
[*] Fixed an issue where low framerates could lead to slightly inconsistent jump distances
[*] Fixed a bug related to enemy engagement AI
[*] Fixed a lingering hitbox on Blind Lurcher fight
[/list]

notes.title: Phosfi Demo Update - 2/16/24
notes.content:
A new update for the Phosfi Demo is now live! Thanks again to everyone who continues to try the demo and provide feedback, these changes are a direct result of your input.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Continued improvement to jump feel
[*] Increased movement speed by ~5%
[*] Increased control responsiveness in air and on ground
[*] Added markers to redisplay tutorials that used to be one time only
[*] Changed some level geometry to streamline the experience
[*] Reduced loading time between levels by ~25%
[*] Changed some prompts to default to 'Yes' option (fast travel, using keys)
[*] Increased chain climbing speed by ~25%
[/list]

[h3]Bug FIxes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that could cause the plyer to respawn on spikes
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the player from bouncing on urchins when i-frames were active
[*] Fixed an issue causing input lag when attacking
[*] Fixed an issue where the player could become stuck in the falling animation when wedged next to a jellyfish
[*] Other small fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Phosfi Demo Update - 2/9/24
notes.content:
Another update for the Phosfi Demo is live! Following more feedback from players over the last week, this update aims to address several common issues encountered with the demo.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Feature Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased jump speed, gravity and "snap" of movement. Also increased base move speed to retain original jump distance and height. Increased inertia of basic movement. [i]As part of an ongoing effort to get movement to feel as good as possible, this update aims to address a common feeling of slowness and floaty-ness. These changes are intended to make the character feel more alive, grounded and responsive[/i]
[*] Changed how relic equipping is displayed and interacted with. [i]Several players were confused by the relic UI (which needs help). This change should make it more obvious what is equipped and how to equip and unequip relics[/i]
[*] Increased dash speed while shortening dash duration. [i]This should make the dash feel quicker while retaining the same distance[/i]
[*] Made boosting off Urchins and jumping off of the Lash ability more consistent
[*] Changed default control scheme. [i]Many players had issues with the default control scheme. While the controls are customizable, this change aims to reduce initial frustration. If you already played the demo but would like to switch to the new default layout, you can use the "reset to default" feature in the controls settings.[/i]
[*] Animation improvements
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with controller deadzones being too large, making movement feel less responsive
[*] Fixed an issue with y-axis input on some controllers
[*] Fixed an issue where navigating the map could feel erratic
[*] Fixed an issue causing players to respawn further away than intended in some areas
[*] Fixed an issue allowing players to boost much higher than intended off Urchins and with the Lash
[/list]

notes.title: Phosfi Demo Update 2/2/24

notes.title: Phosfi Demo Update - 1/27/24
notes.content:
The Demo for Phosfi has been updated based on community feedback, read the full patch notes below.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] Implemented custom map pins feature from full game based on player requests.
[*] Added increased inertia to movements when in shell.
[*] Increased jump speed and responsiveness.
[*] Improved visual fidelity in some areas.
[*] Made some level geometry changes to starting zone for increased clarity in exploration.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where repeatedly jumping in Flotsam would cause you to hover to the ceiling.
[*] Fixed an issue where you could respawn too close to ledges.
[*] Fixed an issue where underwater movement wasn't being properly modified
[*] Fixed a dead-zone issue with some controllers
[/list]

notes.title: Phosfi Demo Update
notes.content:
Thank you to those who have already played the demo and left us feedback! This update addresses the most common issues we've seen and heard about from you. We are constantly working to make Phosfi the best game it can be, and your feedback is incredibly valuable to that process.

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Features/Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made the jump snappier by modifying the jump impulse curve, increasing gravity and reducing hangtime. Other adjustments were made to maintain the same jump height and distance as before.
[*] Increased movement speed while running and rolling in shell form by ~15%
[*] Made some tutorial popups last longer on screen
[*] Improved relic UI to better indicate which relics are active (all UI is still undergoing further improvements and is subject to change)
[*] Increased invincibility frames after taking damage by ~40%
[*] Cooking ingredients are now automatically picked up
[*] Bouncing off a jellyfish now nudges the player into alignment with the resulting jump vector to help with platforming challenges.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a frame delay issue with attack inputs when FPS was low.
[*] Fixed an issue giving players more hangtime on jumps that intended.
[*] Fixed a bug causing dash not to reset when bouncing off a jellyfish in some situations
[*] Added some missing controller button graphics for some controllers
[*] Fixed an issue with control remapping between controller types causing changes not to persist across play sessions
[*] Various UI fixes related to spelling and clarity
[/list]

If you would like to let us know what you think of the demo, feel free to leave comments on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2625450/discussions/0/6208841892243348321/]Demo Feedback Discussion[/url] page!

notes.title: Phosfi Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706624/5efa530e9712d06e0b094995325f34e1035a714b.png[/img]
We're super excited to let you know that free, playable demo for our upcoming game, Phosfi is now available! We'd love to get feedback on the demo and the direction of the game, so if you check it out, let us know on this [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2625450/discussions/0/6208841892243348321/]Community Post[/url]

In a world shrouded by darkness and ruled over by Eldritch monstrosities, embark on a journey to restore the last beacon of light and discover the legacy of the Light Keepers. Reclaim the unique powers of your ancestors and discover the secrets of their past as you fight your way through a large, interconnected world. Explore long lost temples, coastal cliffs, and everything in between while befriending the unique sea-inspired denizens of the land along the way. Forage for unique ingredients and discover powerful (and tasty) recipes as you embark on an epic journey filled with just the right amount of creepy, cozy and tentacles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706624/92e4b8eac51d8a6af57e41b595b10139fdd7c16a.gif[/img]

[h2]Metroidvania style design[/h2]
[list]
[*]Inspired by classic metroidvanias and souls-lite combat.
[*]Combines non-linear exploration and crafting with unique, skill-based combat encounters and platforming challenges.
[/list]
[h2]Hand drawn and hand animated characters and levels[/h2]
[list]
[*] Explore a large variety of unique hand crafted environments.
[*] Discover hidden secrets, ancient relics and strange friends and foes alike.
[*] Mix a little cozy in with your sea monsters - make a home for yourself in the aptly named Pier Town.
[/list]
[h2]Challenging, precision combat[/h2]
[list]
[*] Master an expanding set of combat and movement abilities to defeat ever more challenging foes.
[*] Choose the playstyle that works for you by combining powerful Relics.
[/list]
[h2]Intricate platforming[/h2]
[list]
[*] Utilize an array of fluid movement abilities to conquer even the most complex platforming sequences.
[/list]
[h2]Deep, discoverable lore and mythology[/h2]
[list]
[*] Uncover the mysteries of the past as told through items, conversations and environmental storytelling.
[*] Discover the mythology that drives the world, and come face to face with its Gods.
[/list]
[url=https://discord.gg/d8ARNEXuq7][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44706624/ee9ead09ae5cf6756f6050d189b7cd6d6199e39e.png[/img][/url]

Through lands shrouded by primordial darkness and dominated by creatures of legend, will you embrace your legacy and take up the mantle of the last Light Keeper?
